summary: Advance your strategic communications planning skills and build measurable, executive-ready communication plans. Enroll today.
lede: Strategic communications planning gives communication professionals a structured way to align audiences, narratives, channels, and measures with organizational strategy. This advanced five-day course develops practical skills in stakeholder analysis, message framing, channel planning, campaign roadmapping, risk readiness, and outcome measurement. Through hands-on plan development, case-based simulations, and data-driven critique, you will create stakeholder maps, messaging frameworks, channel architectures, KPIs, dashboards, and evaluation designs. You will also work with planning models such as RACE and communications logic models, while exploring AI-assisted content planning and social listening at a conceptual level.
audienceIntro: This advanced strategic communications planning course is tailored for senior professionals who already manage communications activity and now need to lead integrated plans, align with strategy, and demonstrate measurable impact across complex stakeholder landscapes.
modules: Crisis, Issues, and Risk Communication Planning
Executive Communication and Integrated Plan Presentation
prerequisites: This is an advanced-level program designed for experienced communication and corporate affairs professionals. You should have at least 5 years of hands-on responsibility in public relations, corporate communications, marketing communications, public information, stakeholder engagement, or related roles. You are expected to arrive with practical experience in planning or executing campaigns, drafting key messages, working with senior leaders, and coordinating across channels such as email, intranet, events, media, or digital platforms. No coding is required. Analytics and AI-supported topics focus on operational application and interpretation of dashboards and tools, not technical engineering. Pre-course, you will be invited to bring one real communication initiative or plan that you want to refine; this will be used in exercises throughout the week.
